description:
Search the public web via the configured provider. Results come back as a numbered list of {title, url, snippet} entries. Two providers are supported and the user's choice of provider is set in Settings → Web Search:
- **Brave** (keyword SERP): each hit has a short snippet. Use `web_fetch` on the most relevant 2-3 URLs to read the full page text before quoting or summarizing.
- **Exa** (neural search): each hit also carries the extracted page text inline, so a single `web_search` call is usually enough without a follow-up `web_fetch`. Reach for `web_fetch` only when you need the full document beyond the excerpt shown.

Search is bounded: 10 results max, 1-10 per request. Use `count` to narrow when you only need a few hits. `safesearch` is honored by Brave (`strict` / `moderate` / `off`, default `moderate`) and ignored by Exa. Phrase the query like a search engine: 2-6 specific terms, not a question.

query.description: The search query. Use 2-6 specific terms for best results.

count.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-10, default 10).

safesearch.description: Safe-search level (Brave only; ignored by Exa). Default "moderate".
